justification: Implementing GHG reduction targets can reinforce terrestrial ecosystems restoration by reducing pollution and promoting sustainable land use, thus creating a positive impact on the restoration of ecosystems.
Reducing GHG emissions can enable the restoration of agricultural ecosystems by promoting sustainable agriculture practices and reducing the environmental impact of farming.
GHG reduction efforts can support the restoration of forests by reducing the risk of wildfires and promoting sustainable forest management.
Reducing GHG emissions can help restore marine ecosystems by mitigating the effects of ocean acidification and promoting sustainable fishing practices.
